{{Quote|Our destination was a testing base on Khonji Seven, outside the Brunet system.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]]|<ref name="Death Troopers">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref>}}
'''Khonji Seven''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located just outside the [[Brunet system/Legends|Brunet system]].

It was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] testing base and in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']] was sent to transport a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] to the testing base. However, the Star Destroyer never arrived there due to an outbreak of the virus which decimated the crew.
